name: The last policy disappears
description: Deleting the final agent egress policy removes isolation. Existing intents still pass, while previously restricted connections open.

threat.scope: Known Allow queries only; at most four hops; one shortest path per entrypoint/asset. Unqueried and Unknown edges are excluded, not proven blocked.
threat.sensitivity_scope: Each witness pivot is removed separately and all candidate routes within the same four-hop query scope are searched again. This changes a relay assumption, not network permissions. No path found is not a universal isolation proof.
threat.listener_note: Container ports are declarations, not evidence of a running listener. Missing declarations do not prove a port is closed. Policy-permitted edges are retained in either case.
threat.warning: Conditional exposure under declared relay/compromise assumptions, not a vulnerability or exploit claim. NetworkPolicies do not enforce transitive application authorization.

plan.coverage_note: All changed and intent tuples; no silent sampling.
